text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Taiki Shuttle has invited us to a day at
the
mountain stream. After we meet up
with
Matikanetannhauser, the three of us
wait for our
train.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I can't wait to see it! But weren't you
going to
invite more people?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Everyone had the same story—too busy,
maybe
next time, yadda yadda. It's a
right shame... But
having you two here is
more than enough!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I'm glad to hear it. Maybe next
time we
could all go camping! And
there's always the
Tracen Academy
Summer Walk too.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
That's right! There's so many fun events
ahead!
We could cut a rug 'round the
campfire!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Just something the academy organizes
for
summer! They do a bunch to help us
all relax!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
They even pay for some of our travel! So
let's
take this chance to relax our tails
off!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The academy also runs a training camp
in the
summer. It's a hectic season for
the students, so
these pockets of respite
are all the more
important.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Oh, the train's here! Onward ho, to the
stream we
go!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I'm all done changing! Woohoo, the
water's all
sparkly!
Ugyah! Not to
mention freezing! Brrr!

text_block_list.name: Tannhauser and Taiki
text_block_list.text: 'Kaaay!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The pair frolic in the water and pick
berries with
childish delight.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Watching them play, I'm reminded of the
hugging
dilemma from before. I wonder
if
Matikanetannhauser has already
resolved it.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Doesn't the water feel just grand? The
current's as
smooth as all get-out!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Hup!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! It gets really deep over here! Be
careful!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Hmm!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's bracing against the current. It's not
exactly
a hug, but it might work as
practice for one. Or
maybe this is the
result of her training?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Do you hear that adorable
chirp—oh no!
That baby chick fell out of
its nest!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
We have to save it! Oh, but I remember
hearing
that if you touch a chick, the
parents will
abandon it because your
smell got on it...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
But still! We can't just leave that poor
birdie all
alone! The little thing needs to
go home!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Hey! Taiki?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before I can stop her, Taiki Shuttle is
climbing the
tree, baby bird in her arms.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She makes good progress at first, but
she loses
her footing midway and comes
to a halt.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Whoops! I was so busy mindin' the little
one I
plumb forgot to look at my feet!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
...
Just keep still for a moment!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
It looks like the closest stable foothold
from
where you're at is... Ah, actually,
that spot might
be rotten...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
In that case... I think this spot might be
able to
hold your toes... Yeah, judging
by the diameter, it
should be deep
enough. And from there...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Okay, I think I've got it!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Move your left foot down and to the
right about
twelve centimeters! You'll be
backtracking a
little, but don't worry.
After that, take your right
foot and...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to Matikanetannhauser's precise

directions, Taiki Shuttle makes it to the
nest
safely. And then...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yeehaw, we did it! Thanks a ton,
Tannhauser! The
little chicky made it
home safe and sound!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Yay! Thank you so much, Taiki!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Oh, and the mom's back in the nest too!
I guess
she was keeping watch nearby
the whole time! It
looks like she's got no
problem, thankfully!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Phew! That's a relie—whoa!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Taiki!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Taiki Shuttle briefly loses her balance,
and
Matikanetannhauser shoots up the
tree to
support her. They slowly make
their way back
down.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I owe you one! I was really flailing there.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Are you hurt?! You must've been so
scared!
Ohhhhh, I'm so glad you're safe!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Matikanetannhauser hugs Taiki Shuttle
tight. She
must really have been worried.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Sigh... Thank goodness...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Tannhauser... You've got such a
warm heart!
I'm so happy right now!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I can feel the worry and love just
shootin' off you!
Sorry for giving you a
fright, but thanks for saving
me!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Oh...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
(I get it. Thinking of others, worrying
about them,
and trying to help them...
They're all ways to show
your love. Have
I finally gotten my feelings
across?)

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ehehehe, I get it now. There are a lot of
ways to
show your love.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
And thank you too, Trainer! Don't think I
didn't
see you down there with your
arms out, ready to
break our fall!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I would've rather gone unnoticed, seeing
as I
didn't actually help anything...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Does that count as showing love
too?!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
It sure does! Love and peace make the
world go
round! Get over here! This
one's a group hug!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Unable to hold my ground against their

hug—which is more of a tackle—we fall
into the
stream with a huge splash.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Sorry 'bout that, Trainer! I really had you
worried
back there, didn't I? Here's a
hug to calm you
down!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Don't tell me you're embarrassed? You are! I told you that we need hugging practice!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Did you say hugging practice? Say no
more! I can
give y'all hugs 'til the cows
come home!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I try to explain that I'm not actually
embarrassed,
but in the face of the two
grinning Umamusume,
it proves to be
futile.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Sorry 'bout that, Trainer! I really had you
worried
back there, didn't I?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I ask her not to do anything dangerous
in the
future. I don't even want to think
about if
anything bad were to happen.
choice_data_list: I'm so glad it went by without a hitch...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Exactly! Geez, you had us both worried
sick!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"That goes for you too," I mutter with a
sigh, but I
ultimately keep it to myself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"That goes for you too," I mutter with a
sigh, but I
ultimately keep it to myself.
